in under a second.

COREHOP reads your situation in plain language and ranks every recovery move by meaning, not keywords. No phone tree. No guesswork. One ranked decision surface, instantly.

Why dispatchers run it

A blocked load is a clock. Detention, demurrage, per-diem, a line-down plant, a rejected reefer — every option you don't think of fast enough has a price. COREHOP holds the whole playbook so you don't have to.

[ TIME ]
Minutes, not phone calls
Replace the round of calls to brokers, yards, and carriers with one query. The recovery options surface ranked, instantly, while the window's still open.
[ COST ]
Stop the meter early
Catch the bonded drop, the empty return, the appointment reset before demurrage and detention escalate. The fastest legal move is usually the cheapest one.
[ KNOWLEDGE ]
The whole corridor, on tap
Otay, Tecate, Calexico, CBX, the ports, rail, the maquiladora side — the moves a 20-year dispatcher knows, available to whoever's on shift tonight.
[ TRUST ]
Auditable by design
Every ranking is deterministic and reproducible. No black-box hallucination — the same situation always returns the same scored options, defensible after the fact.

Runs anywhere
you do

[ BROWSER ]
No app to install
COREHOP runs in any modern browser. Your dispatchers log in from the desk, the yard, the cab, or a phone in the inspection line — same access, same speed, anywhere there's a connection.
Desktop · Tablet · Mobile
[ SEAT ]
One login per seat
Simple per-seat access. We provision a login for each operator — no IT project, no integration sprint. Pay for the seats you need and your team is live the same day.
Live in minutes
[ AIR-GAP ]
Or keep it on-prem
For security-sensitive operations, the engine ships as a self-contained Docker container. The whole 26 MB model runs on your own hardware — queries never leave the device, fully air-gapped.
